visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long blonde hair, wearing a dark blue satin sports jersey and grey slippers, struggles to push a large clear plastic storage bin across a light wood floor in front of a plain white wall. (2) She sits behind the bin, leaning her elbows on the lid while talking energetically to the camera; several colorful graphic lines pulse around her. (3) A second person's hands appear from the right, holding up a silver sequined dress inside a plastic garment bag; the blonde woman holds a smartphone displaying a photo of her wearing the dress at an event. (4) The scene cuts to the blonde woman now wearing the silver sequined gown, which features a deep V-neck and a high thigh slit; she poses by holding her shoulders and laughing as floating heart icons appear. (5) Another cut shows the woman back in her jersey, being shown a blue and silver gradient gown; she again holds up a smartphone with a professional photo showing her in a different blue dress. (6) She stands next to a garment bag containing a dark outfit, pointing at it while speaking; she then transitions to wearing a black two-piece outfit consisting of a crop top and a long, sheer black mesh skirt with floral appliqués. (7) She stands in the black outfit, gesturing towards a text overlay containing an email address; she finishes by pointing down toward the bottom of the frame.
